Two fixes to Nxeon's hosting + business-email flows. Work ONLY in worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-hostinv/** (node_modules + .env symlinked to prod). Absolute paths under that dir; never edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-hostinv` for shell. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix ALL errors. No build/deploy/restart, no prisma migrate/generate/db push, no schema change.

FIX A — INVOICE + PDF EMAIL ON HOSTING & EMAIL ORDERS (they currently create neither):
Today a hosting or business-email purchase creates NO `Invoice` row and sends NO order email — the customer only gets a generic wallet-credit "Payment received — $X · your Nxeon order" receipt with no detail. Fix it so they get a real itemised invoice email with the PDF attached.
- Hook point: the CORE placement functions — `orderHostingAccountFor(user, …)` in `lib/actions-hosting.ts` and `orderEmailHostingCore(user, …)` in `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts`. BOTH the wallet-paid and card-paid paths converge on these, so hooking here fires exactly once for either payment method.
- After the account/subscription is created and the wallet is debited successfully, CREATE an `Invoice` using `invoiceCreateData` (exported from `lib/invoices.ts:175`) — mirror the VPS template at `lib/order.ts:818`: `{ userId, description, status:"PAID", taxCents, taxRatePercent, taxCountry, period:{ start:new Date(), end: addMonths(new Date(), termMonths) }, lineItems:[{ description, qty:1, unitCents, amountCents }] }`. Use the ACTUAL charged/debited cents as the amount (match what `debitWallet` took — include tax only if that flow applies it; hosting/email may be untaxed, so use the real debit). Description like `"Web Hosting: Starter for example.com — Monthly"` / `"Business Email: Starter for example.com — Annual"` (plan name + primary domain + term label).
- Then send the invoice email: mirror `lib/order.ts:1013` — build `emails.invoiceNew(...)` and `sendMail({ to: user.email, subject: tpl.subject, html: tpl.html, template: tpl.template, userId: user.id, kind: "invoice", invoiceId: <the created invoice's id> })`. Passing `invoiceId` + the `invoice_new` template makes `lib/mailer.ts` auto-attach the rendered PDF.
- BEST-EFFORT: wrap the invoice-create + email in try/catch so a failure can NEVER fail a placed order (money already moved). Fire once. Do NOT remove the existing wallet-credit receipt (it's a separate document). Confirm you did NOT change any charge/tax/first-month-free logic — only added the invoice record + its email after a successful placement.

FIX B — SELF-SERVE HOSTING CANCEL (currently support-only):
The Danger zone in `components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx` reads "Cancelling this hosting account … is handled by support — contact us to close the account." Give customers a real self-serve cancel.
- Add an OWNER-scoped action `cancelHostingAccount(accountId)` in `lib/actions-hosting.ts` mirroring `adminTerminateHostingAccount` (line ~2029) but gated to the owner: verify the caller owns the account (use the SAME owner-scope helper the other customer hosting actions in this file already use — find it, e.g. an `ownedHostingAccount(accountId)`/`requireUser` + ownership check), then set status `"DELETING"`, call `queueLifecycleTask(id, "TERMINATE")`, write an audit log, `revalidatePath`. Refuse if the account is already `DELETING`, and refuse cleanly if the caller doesn't own it.
- UI: replace the "contact support" line in the Danger zone with a **"Cancel hosting account"** button that requires a STRONG confirmation before calling the action — it's destructive and irreversible (removes files, databases, sites). Use a two-step confirm (e.g. a modal that makes the user type the primary domain to enable the final button), keep the data-loss warning copy, and match the existing hosting UI styling. Show the returned error if any.
- If Business Email subscriptions ALSO lack a self-serve cancel and the pattern is trivially symmetric, add it too — but hosting is the priority; don't over-reach if email cancellation differs.

CONSTRAINTS: reuse `invoiceCreateData`/`emails.invoiceNew`/`sendMail`/`addMonths` + the existing owner-scope + `queueLifecycleTask`/`adminTerminate` pattern; best-effort invoice email; strong confirm on cancel; tsc clean; no deploy/db/schema.

RETURN (final text = data, no preamble): (1) files changed, 1 line each; (2) exactly where the invoice+email is hooked in each core fn, the amount/description/period used, and how it fires once for BOTH wallet & card paths; (3) the cancel action (owner gate + terminate) + the confirm UX; (4) whether you added email cancel; (5) how to test each end-to-end; (6) risks. Branch wt-hostinv, commit nothing.

content.text:
All done. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes clean. Nothing committed. Branch `wt-hostinv`.

**(1) Files changed**
- `lib/actions-hosting.ts` — Fix A invoice+PDF email in `orderHostingAccountFor`; Fix B new owner-scoped `cancelHostingAccount(accountId)`.
- `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts` — Fix A invoice+PDF email in `orderEmailHostingCore`.
- `components/customer/hosting/HostingTabs.tsx` — Danger-zone "contact support" replaced with a self-serve `CancelHostingAccount` component (typed-domain confirm modal).

**(2) Where the invoice+email is hooked / amount / period / fire-once**
- Hosting: in `orderHostingAccountFor`, post-commit (after `db.auditLog.create`, before `revalidatePath`). Amount = `debitedCents`, captured inside the charge tx right after `debitWallet` (so it equals exactly what the wallet was debited — 0 on a granted first-month-free). Description `"Web Hosting: {plan.name} for {name} — {vpsTerm(term).label}"` (e.g. "…— Monthly"). Period `{ start: now, end: addMonths(now, term) }`. Untaxed: `taxCents:0, taxRatePercent:0, taxCountry:null`. Single `lineItems` entry summing to the debit.
- Email: in `orderEmailHostingCore`, post-commit (after audit log). Amount = `debitedCents` (full term charge; email is never first-month-free and untaxed). Description `"Business Email: {plan.name} for {name} — {vpsTerm(term).label}"`. Same period/tax shape.
- Both mirror `lib/order.ts:1013`: `emails.invoiceNew({...}, true)` + `sendMail({ to:user.email, subject, html, template, invoiceId:createdInvoice.id, userId, kind:"invoice" })` — `invoiceId` + `invoice_new` template makes `lib/mailer.ts` auto-attach the rendered PDF.
- **Fires once for BOTH payment methods** because these are the single core placement functions both paths converge on: the wallet path calls them directly (`orderHostingAccount` / `orderEmailHosting`), and the card path funds the wallet first then calls the *same* core (`fulfilCheckoutSession → placeHostingOrderCore → orderHostingAccountFor`; `placeEmailCardOrder → orderEmailHostingCore`). Whole block is wrapped in try/catch, so a failure can never fail a placed order. The existing wallet-credit "Payment received" receipt is untouched. No charge/tax/first-month-free logic changed — only the added record + email after a successful debit.

**(3) Cancel action + confirm UX**
- `cancelHostingAccount(accountId)`: `requireUser` + `assertNotImpersonating`, loads `{userId,status}`, owner gate `a.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN" → "Forbidden."`, refuses if already `DELETING`, then sets status `DELETING`, `queueLifecycleTask(accountId,"TERMINATE")`, audit log (`hosting.cancel`), `revalidatePath` both hosting routes — mirroring `adminTerminateHostingAccount`.
- UI: `CancelHostingAccount` modal — user must type the primary domain exactly (case-insensitive) to unlock the red "Cancel account" button; keeps the irreversible/data-loss warning, matches existing card/btn styling, shows the returned error inline, and on success sends the customer to `/dashboard/hosting`.

**(4) Email self-serve cancel: NOT added.** No cancel exists for email, and the pattern isn't symmetric — there's no lifecycle-task queue for email; a real cancel needs per-mailbox Mailcow deletion with the refuse/unreachable handling from `removeMailbox`. Per the "don't over-reach if email cancellation differs" instruction I left it out.

**(5) How to test end-to-end**
- Fix A (hosting): place a hosting order via the wizard both ways — wallet-only (sufficient balance) and card-funded (toggle "apply balance" off or short balance → Stripe checkout). After each, confirm exactly one new `Invoice` row (status PAID, amount = debited cents, period start→+term) and one `invoice_new` email with the PDF attached; confirm the separate top-up receipt still arrives on the card path only. Then a first-month-free order → verify a $0 PAID invoice/email and no double-send.
- Fix A (email): subscribe a domain to a plan wallet-only and card-funded → same invoice+PDF checks (full term amount).
- Fix B: as the owner on `/dashboard/hosting/{id}` → Settings → Danger zone, click "Cancel hosting account", verify the final button stays disabled until the domain is typed correctly, confirm → account flips to `DELETING`, a `TERMINATE` `HostingTask` is queued, audit `hosting.cancel` written, redirect to the list. Re-invoke → "already being cancelled"; call as a non-owner → "Forbidden."

**(6) Risks**
- Invoice numbering/PDF rely on `invoiceBranding`/`formatInvoiceNumber`/`Invoice.number` exactly as the VPS path uses them (tsc-verified); PDF attachment depends on mailer's `INVOICE_ATTACH_TEMPLATES` including `invoice_new` (already true for VPS).
- $0 first-month-free hosting produces a $0 PAID invoice + "Invoice — $0.00 due" email — intentional as a record; flag if a $0 email is undesirable (easy to gate on `debitedCents > 0`).
- Cancel is irreversible and enqueues a real `TERMINATE`; the provisioner is currently inert until shared hosting is enabled, so in prod today the account will sit in `DELETING` until the worker runs — matches admin-terminate behavior.
- No schema/prisma/build/deploy run (per constraints); the invoice write uses the existing `Invoice` model already used by VPS orders, so no migration needed.
